kind_note: reasoning tier of GPT-6 Astra, sold as a ChatGPT Pro-plan option; the lab's own help center appears to call it 'GPT-6 Pro'
note: No source I opened dates the tier separately from its base model, so release is null and the base model's date is not copied here. Lab (OpenAI) and kind (tier) notes agree with what I found. The only page I opened that names 'GPT-6 Astra Pro' is an OpenRouter model page (https://openrouter.ai/openai/gpt-6-astra-pro), which presents it as its own model and shows no release date; a search summary claimed a September 4, 2026 release from that listing, but the fetched page did not contain that date, so it is unverified. openai.com and help.openai.com returned HTTP 403 and were not opened. Search snippets from those domains say the launch page mentions 'GPT-6 Astra Pro' for Pro, Business and Enterprise users, and that the help center calls the product 'GPT-6 Pro, powered by GPT-6 Astra' for Pro $100, Pro $200, Business and Enterprise plans; these are unverified. Closest opened sentence, from the OpenAI developer community thread (https://community.openai.com/t/introducing-gpt-6-astra-the-most-intelligent-and-aligned-model-in-the-world/1394703): 'GPT-6 Astra is now available to all Pro, Enterprise, and Business Premium users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.' This gives availability to the plan tiers, not a date for the tier itself. The base model GPT-6 Astra appears to have launched on September 3, 2026 per third-party coverage (constellationr.com article page showing 'Published September 3, 2026'); that is a separate record and should be sourced from OpenAI's own announcement before it is used.
